- h5: keep unchanged; confidence=medium; reason=Base anchor h5 is -1.17% vs spot; matched examples suggest a slight downward bias for medium horizons when short-term momentum is flat/negative.
- h20: negative adjustment; confidence=high; magnitude=medium; reason=Base anchor h20 is +3.77% vs spot (overshoot); all matched examples indicate long horizons overshoot and require significant downward correction.
- h30: negative adjustment; confidence=high; magnitude=medium; reason=Base anchor h30 is +6.75% vs spot (overshoot); matched examples consistently show long horizons overshooting and needing strong downward adjustment.
